summary: 9 browser checks + 4 backend test files (9 pytest cases) covering all 8 acceptance criteria. All passed after fixing missing PIN-unlock handling in 5 pre-existing checks (fresh browser contexts hit the pin-lock-screen every time).

checks.criterion: Gate PIN: l'app non è utilizzabile senza PIN
checks.name: pin-lock-gate
checks.evidence: pin-lock-screen visible cold; wrong PIN 0000 -> pin-lock-error shown, screen stays locked; PIN 1987 -> pin-lock-screen disappears, nav-spesa-link visible (dashboard+navbar reachable).

checks.criterion: Lista materiali da comprare per lavoro
checks.name: lavoro-lista-spesa-add-items
checks.evidence: Added catalog item via lista-select-material + lista-input-quantita and free item via lista-modo-libero/lista-input-nome; both appear in lista-items; lista-totale shows 'Spesa stimata'.

checks.name: lavoro-lista-edit-delete-persist
checks.evidence: Edited lista-qty-<id> to 7 and lista-price-<id> to 9.5, closed and reopened lista-modal: values persisted (toHaveValue 7 / 9.5). lista-delete-<id> on a free-text item removed its row.

checks.criterion: Confronto con la giacenza di magazzino
checks.name: lavoro-lista-confronto-giacenza
checks.evidence: Item qty 8 vs giacenza 5 -> row shows 'mancano 3'; after editing qty to 4 -> row shows 'già in magazzino'.

checks.criterion: Carico da lista: spuntare comprato carica la giacenza
checks.name: lavoro-lista-carico-checkbox
checks.evidence: GET /api/materiali before/after lista-toggle-<id> click: quantita_disponibile 5->9 on check (qty 4), back to 5 on uncheck; no double counting.

checks.name: spesa-page-aggregates
checks.evidence: Two jobs (A qty4, B qty6) against materiale with giacenza 2: /spesa spesa-row-<materialeId> shows spesa-mancante-<id> '8' (=10-2) and spesa-cantieri-<id> lists both job titles.

checks.name: preventivo-import-lista
checks.evidence: In /preventivi/nuovo, quote-import-lista-select + btn-import-lista imported both the catalog item and the free-text item as editable material rows; saved quote (GET /api/preventivi/<id>) contains both nomi in voci_materiali and totale_preventivo > 0.

checks.criterion: Funzioni server-only restano attive nell'app completa
checks.name: server-only-features-present
checks.evidence: /materiali shows btn-import-listino; preventivo detail page shows btn-email-quote and btn-download-pdf, all visible in the full (non-static) build.

checks.criterion: Backend API coverage: lista-spesa add/validate/carico/unica (supports criteria 2,4,5,6)
checks.name: test_tscheck_lista_spesa_carico.py / test_tscheck_lista_spesa_unica.py / test_tscheck_lista_spesa_validazioni.py / test_tscheck_dashboard.py
checks.evidence: pytest -q: 9 passed in 1.31s (all 4 test files, no failures, no test_error).

action_items: Pre-existing browser checks (dashboard-shows-kpis, lavoro-lista-spesa-add-items, lavoro-lista-confronto-giacenza, lavoro-lista-carico-checkbox, spesa-page-aggregates) lacked PIN-unlock handling and failed on a fresh browser context; updated all 5 to unlock with PIN 1987 before proceeding. No app code was touched.
